service.name: Wedding music in Vail
service.serviceType: Live music for weddings in Vail: ceremony guitarist, cocktail hour duo, band and DJ
service.description: Live wedding music in Vail and the Vail Valley: an acoustic, jazz or Spanish guitarist for an outdoor ceremony, a jazz or acoustic duo for the cocktail hour, a band or DJ for the reception, on one contract with sound included and one I-70 travel line.

faqs.q: Do you play weddings in Vail?
faqs.a: Yes, the whole day or any one part of it. Vail is an I-70 corridor date from Denver, so the music is quoted at the same fee a Denver wedding sees plus one travel line for the drive over the passes, with no lodging line. The Sonnenalp, the Four Seasons Resort Vail, The Arrabelle at Vail Square, The Hythe, the Grand Hyatt Vail and Donovan Pavilion are the venues that come up most.

faqs.q: What does the Vail travel line cover?
faqs.a: The drive up I-70 and back for the musicians and the gear, as one line on the quote. Vail sits inside the corridor we price as a single travel line, so there is no mileage arithmetic and no night's lodging, which the far resorts like Aspen and Telluride do carry. Winter dates are planned with Vail Pass in mind, and the musicians travel early.

faqs.q: Can a band play an outdoor wedding in Vail?
faqs.a: Yes, with the village noise cap in the plan from the start. Vail's outdoor limit in the resort villages was reported at 65 dBA measured ten feet from the permitted area, which a ceremony guitarist and a cocktail hour duo sit inside on their own. A dance floor runs louder than that by design, so the floor goes indoors or onto a venue's own permitted terrace, and we confirm the current figure with the venue before the day.

faqs.q: Does the altitude change anything for the musicians?
faqs.a: It changes the sound check. At 8,150 feet the air is thin and dry, singers and horn players pace themselves differently, and the temperature swing between an afternoon ceremony and an evening set means instruments drift and get retuned. We plan a longer sound check for it, and an outdoor ceremony gets a covered, level and dry spot with power run to it.

faqs.q: How far ahead should we book wedding musicians in Vail?
faqs.a: Earlier than in the city. A mountain venue books its Saturdays twelve to eighteen months out, and couples in wedding forums report booking music after the venue and before most of the rest of the list. Tell us the date and we'll come back quickly with an answer and a price for that day.
